name: StandupVR
summary:
A little space to think together.

StandupVR brings a small team into a calm studio with warm timber, plants and landscape windows. Host a room, share its eight-character invitation code privately, and meet from different locations with up to six people.

Put your work on the wall. Open https://standupvr.quest/present/ in Chrome on a Mac, connect with the same code, and choose a tab or window. Keep Linear signed in on your own Mac while teammates see the shared image in Quest. No native Mac app is needed. E
